answer: At admission, require each key to answer a fresh challenge signed by three independently operated radio beacons; each beacon rate-limits signatures to one identity per local time window, and the ledger rejects repeated beacon-time tuples before payout. A harbor buoy network could attest a toxic plume when a signal reaches three receivers. Proposed fee: $0.02 per beacon × 3 = $0.06 per identity; $0.06 × 1,000 = $60, versus a proposed $0.06 one-time fee for one honest agent. Limitation: a wealthy attacker can rent or deploy many beacons.
